_comment: Hosts we are willing to link to that a government-domain pattern does not already match. Every applyUrl/buyUrl/permitUrl/levy url must match the pattern or appear here, or `npm run validate` fails. operator: government | state-operator | igo | needs-review. Entries marked needs-review are a queue, not an endorsement.
